newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa lower in thin trade.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa lower in thin trade.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa eased in thin trade but it never went down as far as the six or seven stg lower opening call.

"It's been a very quiet morning with no major industry buying or origin selling," one trader said. "The range gets narrower and narrower," he said. The market was waiting for a signal from the industry or origins, he said.
"The longer it stays quiet the more violent the next move will be," he said.
By the midday break July was three stg lower at 1,021 stg, having seen a low of 1,019 stg. Volume on July was 703 of a total 1,292 lots.
Technical analysts did not expect cocoa to overcome the immediate 1,035 hurdle on July.
Barry Callebaut AG said on Tuesday it planned to increase its cocoa processing capacity in the Ivory Coast.
